'''Isdam Edian''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a [[security officer]] in the [[Bespin Wing Guard]], which was based in [[Cloud City]] on the [[gas giant]] [[Bespin]]. After the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] was frozen in [[carbonite]] by [[Baron Administrator]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and the [[Galactic Empire]], Edian and another security [[officer]] accompanied the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]], who had helped capture Solo, while transporting the frozen smuggler through the corridors of Cloud City to Fett's [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|starship]], ''[[Slave I]]''.

==Biography==
Isdam Edian<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#239: Bespin Security Guard (Isdam Edian)|altlink=https://www.jedinews.com/collecting/articles/star-wars-hasbro-fan-celebration-reveals-vintage-collection-bespin-security-guard-isdam-edian}}</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="ESB" /> who served as a [[security officer]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> in the [[Bespin Wing Guard]], a [[law enforcement agency]]<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> based on [[Cloud City]] on the [[gas giant]] [[Bespin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ESB" /> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Empire]] arrived in the [[city]] and forced its [[Baron Administrator]], [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], to help them capture the rebel [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]].<ref name="ESB" />

[[File:Wing_Guards_Fett.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Isdam Edian helped transport the frozen Han Solo through Cloud City.]]

After he was captured with the aid of [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]], Solo was frozen in [[carbonite]] within Cloud City's [[carbon-freezing chamber]]. Once it had been confirmed that Solo survived the process, the carbonite block containing the smuggler was given to Fett, who had Edian and another security [[officer]] transport it through the corridors of Cloud City to his<ref name="ESB" /> [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]], ''[[Slave I]]'',<ref name="USWNE" /> which was parked on the [[East Platform]].<ref name="ESB" />

Enroute, Edian and the other officer walked with Fett and two Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s, although Fett briefly dropped back to open fire upon [[Luke Skywalker]], an ally of Solo who the hunter had spotted lurking in one of the corridors. At the [[Starship|ship]], the other officer pushed Solo up the ramp onto ''Slave I'', after which Fett successfully launched from the platform while under fire from Solo's allies.<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
Isdam Edian had dark skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and black [[hair]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
Edian wore a Wing Guard [[Clothing|uniform]], which was blue with gold trim and including a [[Hat|cap]], red bracers,<ref name="ESB" /> a black [[holster]], and black [[boot]]s. He used a [[Relby K-23 blaster pistol]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
Isdam Edian was portrayed by [[Quentin Pierre]]<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=https://starwarsinterviews.com/original-trilogy/episode-v-the-empire-strikes-back/quentin-pierre-sergeant-edian|text=Quentin Pierre (Sergeant Edian)|author=Pellegrom, Dennis|date=2010-05|archivedate=20220319104057|nolive=1}}</ref> in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Edian was first identified on a [[2022]] action figure released as part of the ''[[Star Wars Vintage Collection]]'' produced by [[Hasbro]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the character was initially identified as "Sergeant [[Isdam Edian/Legends|Edian]]" on a card in the [[1998]] "[[Special Edition Limited]]" set for the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Sergeant Edian}}</ref> Edian the received the first name Isdam in "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards"]], an article written by [[Tim Veekhoven]], [[Kevin Beentjes]], and [[Sander de Lange]] published in [[Star Wars Insider 148|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]]<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}}</ref> on [[March 11]], [[2014]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/148|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #148}}</ref>
